entries.description: Applicable when taxpayer's TDS + TCS during the year is ₹25,000 or more (₹50,000 for senior citizens), or savings bank deposits total ₹50 lakhs or more — making them liable to file even if income is below the basic exemption limit.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer declares. Flag is raised if AIS or 26AS reflects high TDS or large deposit transactions.
entries.validationSource: AIS and 26AS — TDS/TCS totals and SFT data for large bank deposits.
entries.conflictTrigger: High TDS visible in AIS/26AS but the taxpayer does not flag this — discrepancy noted and taxpayer is prompted to confirm.

entries.description: Required. Total of salary under section 17(1) + value of perquisites under 17(2) + profits in lieu of salary under 17(3) + income under section 89A. Validation Rule 59.
entries.primarySource: Form 16 Part B — Gross Salary box. If Form 16 is unavailable, AIS salary data is used as the starting point.
entries.validationSource: Form 26AS Schedule of TDS under section 192 reflects gross salary paid. AIS Salary tile.
entries.conflictTrigger: Gross salary from Form 16 does not match AIS salary data — discrepancy resolution is triggered. Taxpayer is asked to confirm the correct figure or provide a revised Form 16. If the taxpayer has two employers in the same year (e.g., mid-year job change) — both Form 16s must be captured. The product must check whether both employers have correctly deducted TDS on the combined income. If one employer was unaware of the other income and under- deducted, this will show up as a mismatch between total salary declared and total TDS in 26AS. The taxpayer is informed and any shortfall is computed as self- assessment tax.

entries.description: Components of Gross Salary: • Salary as per section 17(1) • Value of perquisites under 17(2) • Profits in lieu of salary under 17(3) Each reported separately.

entries.validationSource: AIS salary component breakup.

entries.description: Income from a retirement benefit account held in a country notified under section 89A (USA, UK, Canada). Reported separately.

entries.description: Required. GTI minus Chapter VI-A deductions. Minimum value is zero. ITR-1 cap: total income excluding LTCG must not exceed ₹50,00,000 — Rule 117.

entries.description: Exempt income must be declared separately — agriculture income, PF receipts, pension from gallantry awardees, insurance policy receipts, scholarships, etc. Note: Gratuity under Section 10(10) must NOT be reported here. For ITR-1 filers (salaried taxpayers), gratuity is an exempt allowance within the Salary schedule (AllwncExemptU s10) and must be reported there to correctly offset the Gross Salary figure. Reporting it here as well will result in a double-count and a Category A mismatch on Net Salary. Each category can appear only once — Rule 185.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer declares. For agricultural income: land records or Kisan passbook.
entries.validationSource: AIS Exempt Income tile.
entries.conflictTrigger: Agriculture income exceeds ₹5,000 — Category A (Rule 29). Same exempt income category selected more than once — Category A (Rule 185).

entries.description: 80CCC 80CCDEmployeeOrSE Combined cap of ₹1,50,000 for 80C + 80CCC + 80CCD(1) together — Old Regime only. New Regime: none of these can be claimed — Rule 1, 154. Covers: LIC premiums, EPF, PPF, ELSS, school tuition fees, NSC, home loan principal, etc.

entries.validationSource: AIS: insurance premium payments, EPF and PPF data. Schedule 80C item totals must match VIA claim — Rules 251, 257.
entries.conflictTrigger: Old Regime: combined 80C + 80CCC + 80CCD(1) exceeds ₹1,50,000 — Category A (Rule 1). New Regime: any claim under these sections — Category A (Rule 154).

entries.description: Additional NPS contribution by employee — over and above the ₹1,50,000 limit. Cap: ₹50,000 (Old Regime). New Regime: not allowed. PRAN number is mandatory — Rule 234.

entries.validationSource: NPS Trust / NSDL CRA records.
entries.conflictTrigger: Old Regime: exceeds ₹50,000 — Category A. New Regime: any claim — Category A (Rule 170). PRAN not provided — submission blocked.

entries.description: Employer's NPS contribution on behalf of the employee. Cap varies by employer type: • Central/State Govt employer: 14% of salary — Rule 121 • Other employers: 10% of salary — Rule 4 • New Regime (PSU, Others, Govt): 14% of salary — Rule Pensioners and 'Not Applicable' category cannot claim this — Rule 116.
entries.primarySource: Form 16 Part B — employer NPS contribution row.
entries.validationSource: AIS NPS Employer Contribution data.
entries.conflictTrigger: Pensioner or 'Not Applicable' employer category + this deduction claimed — Category A (Rule 116). Amount exceeds the applicable percentage cap — Category A.

entries.description: Health insurance premium deduction — Old Regime only. New Regime: not allowed — Rule 174. Caps: • Self and Family (non-senior): ₹25,000 — Rule 128 • Self and Family (senior citizen): ₹50,000 — Rule 131 • Parents (non- senior): ₹25,000 — Rule 133 • Parents (senior citizen): ₹50,000 — Rule 135 • Combined maximum: ₹1,00,000 — Rule 137 • Preventive health check-up: combined max ₹5,000 — Rule Insurer name and policy number are mandatory — Rules 266–269.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80D: health insurance premium receipts. Insurer name, policy number, and premium amount per insured person required.
entries.validationSource: AIS insurance premium payment data.
entries.conflictTrigger: Any individual or combined cap exceeded — Category A. New Regime: any claim — Category A. Insurer name or policy number missing when premium is claimed — blocked.

entries.description: Deduction for medical treatment of a dependent with a disability — Old Regime only. • Disability (40– 80%): ₹75,000 — Rule 212 • Severe disability (80%+): ₹1,25,000 — Rule 213 Dependent relationship, PAN or Aadhaar of dependent, and Form 10IA acknowledgemen t (for autism/cerebral palsy/multiple disabilities) required.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80DD: disability certificate, dependent details, Form 10IA if applicable.
entries.validationSource: UDID database where applicable.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim — Category A (Rule 155). Amount does not match the applicable fixed slab — Category A. Deduction claimed but required details not provided — blocked (Rule 215).

entries.description: Deduction for treatment of specified diseases — Old Regime only. New Regime: not allowed — Rule 156. Caps: • Resident (non- senior citizen): ₹40,000 — Rule 7 • Senior Citizen: ₹1,00,000 — Rule 5 Disease must be from the notified list. Name of disease and patient details are mandatory — Rule 249.
entries.primarySource: Medical certificate from a specialist doctor. Disease name (from notified list) and patient details required.
entries.validationSource: No government API. Taxpayer- provided certificate only.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim — Category A. Amount exceeds the applicable cap — Category A. Disease or patient details not provided — blocked.

entries.description: Interest paid on education loan. No monetary cap — entire interest paid is deductible. Old Regime. Bank name and loan details mandatory — Rule 235.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80E: bank certificate showing interest paid in the year.
entries.validationSource: AIS loan interest data if reported by bank.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim — blocked. Bank details not provided — blocked (Rule 235). Schedule 80E total does not match VIA claim — blocked (Rule 252, 258).

entries.description: 80EEA 80EEB Additional interest deductions on housing or vehicle loans: • 80EE: First home loan ≤ ₹35L, sanctioned Apr 2016–Mar 2017. Cap ₹50,000 — Rule 122, 237, 262 • 80EEA: Affordable housing loan (stamp duty value ≤ ₹45L), sanctioned Apr 2019–Mar 2022. Cap ₹1,50,000 — Rule 123, 239, 240 • 80EEB: Electric vehicle loan, sanctioned Apr 2019–Mar 2023. Cap ₹1,50,000 — Rule 125, 242 Note: 80EE and 80EEA cannot both be claimed — Rule 124.
entries.primarySource: Loan sanction certificate and interest certificate from the lending bank. Loan sanction date must fall within the specified window.
entries.validationSource: AIS loan data. Bank details in 80EE/80EEA must also appear in Schedule 24(b) — Rules 231, 232.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim under any of these — blocked. 80EE and 80EEA both non-zero — Category A (Rule 124). Sanction date outside the applicable window — blocked. Stamp duty value exceeds ₹45L for 80EEA — blocked. Loan amount exceeds ₹35L for 80EE — blocked. Bank details not in Schedule 24(b) — blocked.

entries.description: Donations to approved funds and charitable institutions. Old Regime only. New Regime: not allowed — Rule 157. Donation in cash above ₹2,000 is not allowed — Rule 88. Donee PAN must be provided and must not match taxpayer's own PAN — Rule 78. Same Donee PAN cannot appear more than once — Rule 118.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80G: donation receipts with Donee name, PAN, ARN, address, amount in cash versus other mode.
entries.validationSource: Donee PAN verification. NGO/Trust registration database.
entries.conflictTrigger: 80G claimed in VIA but Schedule 80G not filled — Category A (Rule 8). Cash donation exceeds ₹2,000 — disallowed (Rule 88). Donee PAN equals taxpayer PAN — Category A (Rule 78). New Regime: any claim — Category A (Rule 157).

entries.description: Rent paid deduction for taxpayers who do not receive HRA. Maximum is the least of: ₹60,000 per year, 25% of total income, or excess of rent paid over 10% of total income — Rule 114. Form 10BA must be filed — Category D Rule 4. Cannot be claimed alongside HRA exemption for the same period — Rule 120.
entries.primarySource: Form 10BA acknowledgem ent number. Monthly rent amount and landlord details declared by taxpayer.
entries.validationSource: AIS data. If HRA under 10(13A) has been claimed, 80GG is blocked.
entries.conflictTrigger: HRA exemption and 80GG both claimed — Category A (Rule 120). Amount exceeds the applicable limit — blocked. Form 10BA not filed — Category D warning.

entries.description: Donations to scientific research or rural development organisations. New Regime: not allowed — Rule 176. Cash donations above ₹2,000 not allowed — Rule 144. Donee PAN must not match taxpayer PAN — Rule 94.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80GGA: donation receipts with Donee PAN, cash / other mode split.
entries.validationSource: Donee PAN verification.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim — blocked. Cash donation exceeds ₹2,000 — disallowed. Details not provided when deduction is claimed — blocked (Rule 91).

entries.description: Contributions to registered political parties. Only contributions in modes other than cash are allowed. Date of contribution must fall between 01- Apr-2024 and 31- Mar-2025 for AY 2025-26 — Rule 220.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80GGC: contribution receipts, date of contribution, mode of payment.
entries.validationSource: Electoral trust or political party contribution records.
entries.conflictTrigger: Cash contribution — not eligible. Contributio n date outside AY 2024-25 — blocked. Details not provided — blocked (Rules 207, 208).

entries.description: Savings account interest deduction. Maximum ₹10,000. Old Regime only. Not available to Senior Citizens — they must use 80TTB instead — Rule 13.
entries.primarySource: AIS Interest tile — savings account interest.
entries.validationSource: AIS savings interest data.
entries.conflictTrigger: Old Regime: exceeds ₹10,000 — Category A (Rule 11). Taxpayer is a Senior Citizen (born on or before 01- Apr-1965): cannot claim 80TTA — Category A (Rule 13). New Regime: any claim — Category A (Rule 158).

entries.description: Interest income deduction for Senior Citizens (age 60 and above). Covers savings, FD, and deposit interest. Maximum ₹50,000. Old Regime only.
entries.primarySource: AIS Interest tile — total bank and deposit interest for senior citizen taxpayers.
entries.validationSource: AIS data.
entries.conflictTrigger: Taxpayer is below 60 years of age — cannot claim 80TTB — Category A (Rule 15). New Regime: any claim — Category A (Rule 159).

entries.description: Self-disability deduction — Old Regime only. • Disability (40– 80%): ₹75,000 — Rule 210 • Severe disability (80%+): ₹1,25,000 — Rule 209 Form 10IA acknowledgemen t required for autism, cerebral palsy, or multiple disabilities. UDID number required.
entries.primarySource: Schedule 80U: nature of disability, disability certificate, UDID number, Form 10IA if applicable.
entries.validationSource: UDID database where applicable.
entries.conflictTrigger: New Regime: any claim — blocked. Amount does not match applicable slab — Category A. Required documents not provided — blocked (Rule 216).

entries.description: Agniveer Corpus Fund contribution under section 80CCH. Available only to Central Government employees enrolled in the Agnipath scheme, aged 17–27 years at time of joining. Maximum: 46.2% of salary under section 17(1) — Rule 195.
entries.primarySource: Payroll certificate from the Ministry of Defence or Central Government employer for Agniveer scheme enrolees. This field is applicable to a very small subset of ITR- 1 filers and is handled as a manual declaration.
entries.validationSource: Ministry of Defence payroll records.
entries.conflictTrigger: Non-Central Govt employee claims this — blocked (Rule 196). Amount exceeds 46.2% of salary — Category A (Rule 195).

entries.description: Required. Sum of all individual deductions above. Cannot exceed Gross Total Income — Rules 17, 18.
entries.primarySource: Computed.
entries.validationSource: Formula check.
entries.conflictTrigger: Total exceeds GTI — capped at GTI (Rule 18). Sum does not match individual totals — Category A (Rule 17).

entries.description: Required. Tax on Total Income computed as per the applicable slab rates for Old or New Regime.
entries.primarySource: Computed based on Total Income and the regime selected.
entries.validationSource: Verified against published slab rate tables for AY 2025-26.
entries.conflictTrigger: Tax computed does not match expected slab-based output — internal calculation error. Must be resolved before the return is filed.

entries.description: Rebate for resident individual taxpayers. Maximum ₹25,000. Old Regime: available if Total Income (including LTCG) does not exceed ₹5,00,000. Rebate up to ₹12,500 — Rule 201. New Regime: available if Total Income excluding LTCG does not exceed ₹7,22,230. Rebate up to ₹25,000 — Rule 200.
entries.primarySource: Computed and applied automatically based on Total Income and regime.
entries.validationSource: Total income computation output.
entries.conflictTrigger: Old Regime: Total Income (including LTCG) exceeds ₹5,00,000 but rebate is claimed — Category A (Rule 23). New Regime: Total Income excluding LTCG exceeds ₹7,22,230 but rebate is claimed — Category A (Rule 200).

entries.description: Required. Health and Education Cess at 4% of (Tax after Rebate). Rule 26.
entries.primarySource: Computed.
entries.validationSource: Formula: (TaxPayableOnRe bate × 4%).
entries.conflictTrigger: Value is not 4% of tax after rebate — Category A (Rule 26).

entries.description: Relief for arrears or advance salary under section 89(1). Form 10E must be filed on the e- filing portal before this relief is claimed — Rule 126, Category D Rule 3.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer provides details of arrears. Form 10E acknowledgem ent from the portal.
entries.validationSource: Form 10E filed on the e-filing portal.
entries.conflictTrigger: Salary or perquisite figures are nil but relief under 89 is claimed — Category A (Rule 126). Form 10E not filed — Category D warning. The relief claim may not be accepted.

entries.description: (234A, 234B, 234C, 234F) Interest for: • Late filing — 234A • Shortfall in advance tax — 234B • Deferment of advance tax instalments — 234C • Late filing fee — 234F (max ₹5,000; ₹1,000 if income ≤ ₹5L) All are computed based on filing date and advance tax paid.
entries.primarySource: Computed based on filing date, advance tax payment schedule, and tax liability.
entries.validationSource: Advance tax payment dates and amounts from Schedule IT (challan records).
entries.conflictTrigger: Total interest and fee does not match the sum of 234A + 234B + 234C + 234F — Category A (Rules 27, 28).

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. Total TDS credit claimed. Must equal sum of TDS Schedule 1 (salary) + TDS Schedule 2 (other income) + TDS Schedule 3 (rent) — Rules 103, 104, 108.
entries.primarySource: Auto- populated from Form 26AS and AIS. Taxpayer reviews each TDS entry before confirming.
entries.validationSource: TRACES Form 26AS — the authoritative record of all TDS deductions. AIS TDS tile.
entries.conflictTrigger: TDS claimed exceeds TDS shown in Form 26AS — discrepancy resolution triggered. Taxpayer is asked to reconcile with the employer or bank. TDS credit claimed but the correspondi ng income has not been declared — Category A (Rule 113). Product must ensure income and TDS credits are always matched.

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. Total TCS credit claimed — Rules 96, 97, 109.
entries.primarySource: Auto- populated from Form 26AS TCS schedule.
entries.validationSource: TRACES 26AS TCS data.
entries.conflictTrigger: TCS claimed exceeds TCS collected as per 26AS — Category A (Rule 96).

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. Total advance tax paid between 01-Apr- 2024 and 31- Mar-2025. Reconciled against challan entries in Schedule IT — Rule 110.
entries.primarySource: Challan details entered by taxpayer: BSR code, challan serial number, date, and amount.
entries.validationSource: OLTAS challan payment records verifiable through the NSDL portal.
entries.conflictTrigger: Advance tax total does not equal the sum of Schedule IT challans within the advance tax date range — Category A (Rule 110).

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. Self- assessment tax paid on or after 01-Apr-2025. Reconciled against Schedule IT — Rule 111.
entries.primarySource: Challan details for tax paid after the financial year end.
entries.validationSource: OLTAS challan verification.
entries.conflictTrigger: SAT total does not equal Schedule IT entries dated after 31-Mar-2025 — Category A (Rule 111).

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. TDS + TCS + Advance Tax + Self- Assessment Tax — Rule 104.
entries.primarySource: Computed.
entries.validationSource: Formula check.
entries.conflictTrigger: Sum does not match component s— Category A.

entries.section: 12 Taxes Paid — TDS, TCS, Advance Tax, Self-Ass
entries.description: Required. Total tax and interest payable minus Total Taxes Paid. Minimum zero — Rule 106.
entries.primarySource: Computed.
entries.validationSource: Formula check.

entries.description: Required. Total Taxes Paid minus Total Tax and Interest Payable, if positive — Rule 105.
entries.primarySource: Computed.
entries.validationSource: Formula check.
entries.conflictTrigger: Refund amount does not match formula — Category A.

entries.description: Required. IFSC code of the bank account nominated for refund credit — Rule 107. At least one account must be marked as the refund account.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer provides bank account details during onboarding.
entries.validationSource: RBI IFSC master database and GIFT IFSC codes. Validated in real time.
entries.conflictTrigger: IFSC code not found in RBI database — Category A (Rule 107). No account marked for refund — submission blocked.

entries.description: Required. Bank account number, maximum 20 characters.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer provided.
entries.validationSource: Validated via penny-drop or micro-deposit verification.
entries.conflictTrigger: Account number fails validation — blocked.

entries.description: Required. Whether the taxpayer works in a metro city (Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata) or non- metro. Metro: HRA cap is 50% of salary. Non-Metro: 40% of salary.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer declares city of work.
entries.validationSource: None — taxpayer declaration.

entries.description: Required. Actual HRA received from the employer during the year.
entries.primarySource: Form 16 Part B — HRA component.
entries.validationSource: AIS salary breakup.

entries.description: Required. Actual annual rent paid by the taxpayer.
entries.primarySource: Rent receipts or bank transfer records. Lease agreement as supporting document.
entries.validationSource: AIS rent data if available. Form 26AS TDS under 194IB (tenant TDS) if monthly rent exceeds ₹50,000.
entries.conflictTrigger: HRA claimed exceeds actual rent paid minus 10% of salary — blocked (Rule 271). HRA claimed exceeds 50% (metro) or 40% (non-metro) of salary — blocked (Rule 272).

entries.description: Required. Eligible HRA exemption = lowest of: (a) Actual HRA received (b) Actual rent paid minus 10% of (salary + DA) (c) 40% or 50% of (salary + DA) based on city type Rule 273.
entries.primarySource: Computed from the three inputs above.
entries.validationSource: Cross-checked against HRA exemption claimed in the salary schedule — Rule 278.
entries.conflictTrigger: HRA exemption in salary schedule does not match the eligible amount computed here — Category A (Rule 278). New Regime: any HRA exemption claimed — Category A (Rules 150, 166).

entries.description: Required. The taxpayer (or authorised representative) declares that the information furnished is true and correct to the best of their knowledge.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer confirms during final review before submission.
entries.validationSource: None.

entries.description: Required. S = Self, R = Representative. For an individual filing their own return, this will always be 'S'.
entries.primarySource: Auto-set based on who is completing the filing.
entries.validationSource: None.

entries.description: Required. City from which the return is being filed. Maximum 50 characters.
entries.primarySource: Taxpayer declares at time of final submission.
entries.validationSource: None.
